pred_texts: Instruct: First grab an apple and a knife.
Instruct: Now cut the apple into thin slices.
Instruct: Now get a microwave safe plate and place the apple pieces on it. Make sure that the apple slices are on their side.
Instruct: Now sprinkle cinnamon and sugar over the apple slices.
Instruct: Now let's microwave the apple slices until they are soft. You can microwave for about one minute.
Instruct: Now take a slice of bread and toast it until it is golden and crispy, for about one minute.
Instruct: Now put the apple slices on top of the toast.
Feedback: You're doing great! Now, let's move on to the next step. Please put the apple slices on top of the toast.
